context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: パーカー/出前/おとり/真っ青/ガット/月々/街路/ソープ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、パーカー、絶対、ママ、絶対、買ってあげたわよ
lines.en: Sho, I really did buy you that new hoodie, you know.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Gentle emphasis on the certainty, like tucking in a fact he might worry about. Open, generous tone—she's reassuring him without being asked.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、今日の夕飯、絶対、出前、絶対、頼みたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to order delivery for dinner tonight.
lines.style: Quiet, tentative pitch upward at the end. Testing the waters, hopeful but braced for no. The specific politeness of a child asking for something small he thinks might be refused.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 警察ドラマで、本気で、絶対、おとり、絶対、捜査、絶対、ママ、絶対、見たわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I saw a police drama the other day where they were doing an undercover sting, Sho.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking-aloud. Warm beat before the connection lands. Slow enough that he can hear her working through why she's telling him this. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、テストの結果、絶対、見て、絶対、真っ青、絶対、になっちゃった
lines.en: When I saw my test results, I turned completely pale.
lines.style: Self-aware wry smile in the voice. Light, like he's already learned to laugh at his own panic. Understated—not seeking comfort, just stating the fact of his anxiety.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんのテニスラケット、本気で、絶対、ガット、絶対、張り替え、絶対、必要らしいわ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad's tennis racket needs the strings restrung, apparently.
lines.style: Observant, slightly amused. Soft exhale like ticking off another thing on a list no one asked her to keep. Warm underneath—not complaining, just noticing the weight of small expenses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、習い事の、絶対、月々、絶対、お月謝、絶対、お父さん、絶対、払ってるんだよね
lines.en: Your dad's the one paying for your lessons every month, you know.
lines.style: Gentle directness. She's not accusing, just helping him see the whole picture. Warm steady tone—speaking plainly about something he's old enough to understand. Eye-level honesty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 桜の、本気で、絶対、街路、絶対、樹、絶対、咲き始めたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The cherry blossoms on the street have started blooming, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. She's sharing something she noticed—a small kindness in the middle of all the other things. Quiet joy, not performed. Letting the moment settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂で、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、ソープ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、使ったよ、ママ
lines.en: I used that new soap you got in the bath earlier, Mom.
lines.style: Animated, bright-eyed. Eager to share something small that happened to him. Innocent pride in noticing and trying the new thing. Unguarded, open-faced energy.
